CCNL piccola e media industria alimentare Unionalimentari-Confapi 2024-2028, testo firmato Roma 18 marzo 2026 (scansione, copia UILA)

notes.text: Salary model: split. base_salary = paga base (changes each tranche); fixed_allowances = contingenza (per-level, frozen since 1993 Protocol) + EDR 10.33 (all levels, per Protocol 31/07/1992 Art. 1.1).

Hourly divisor 173 confirmed from primary source: Art. 4.3 CCNL text (lavorofacile.it). Cross-check: level 8 Jan 2026 total = 1204.73 + 514.74 + 10.33 = 1729.80; 1729.80 / 173 = 10.00 EUR/h exactly. Art. 4.4 sets the normal workweek at 39h; computing 39 x 52 / 12 = 169h/month, not 173. The CCNL resolves this by stating the coefficient explicitly in Art. 4.3 — the arithmetic cross-check confirms 173 is the operative value.
Additional months: 14 confirmed from Art. 4.1 CCNL text (mensilita: 14). Art. 5.3 = tredicesima, Art. 5.4 = quattordicesima.
Seniority: 5 biennali per Art. 5.5 CCNL text (settore alimentare). Fixed EUR amounts from 2021 CCNL; 2025 Unionalimentari circular (28/05/2025) makes no mention of changes to scatti amounts.
Salary tranches: 01/06/2025, 01/01/2026, 01/04/2027 and 01/01/2028, EUR 70 each at parametro 137 (art. 47 of the verbale of 28 May 2025 and of the consolidated text signed on 18 March 2026).
Apprenticeship: Art. 8.1 CCNL — under-classification model, levels 1 through 7, multi-period per destination level. Complex schedule not publicly parsed in full. layer_2 = out_of_scope.

PANIFICAZIONE INDUSTRIALE (text signed 18 March 2026): levels P1, P2, P3A, P3B, P4, P5, P6 (1°, 2°, 3A, 3B, 4°, 5°, 6°) only for an employer of the sub-sector panificazione_industriale, on a ladder of their own: paga base (4 tranches of EUR 70 at 3B), contingenza of art. 47 bis, premio di produzione nazionale (14 months, out of the TFR by the exhaustive list of art. 59), premio per obiettivi of the sector in place of art. 53 (12 months) and five biennial scatti frozen at the 1997 amounts. No EDR: the signed text names none for the sector.

TRANCHES 2027-2028 (art. 47): 70.00 EUR at parametro 137 from 1 April 2027 and again from 1 January 2028, as in the verbale signed 28 May 2025 (p. 26) and the consolidated text signed 18 March 2026 (PDF p. 144). The association circular's prose giving 32 EUR for the third tranche is wrong. Where the two signed tables differ by a cent the later text is used: it adds each increment to the previous minimo exactly (e.g. 3rd level 1,987.81 from 1 January 2026, 1,987.80 in the verbale).

reviews.scope: The accrual rule of the tredicesima (fractions of a month) against the full CCNL text.
findings: Art. 48 - Tredicesima mensilità (p. 127): "Nel caso di inizio o di cessazione del rapporto di lavoro durante il corso dell’anno, il lavoratore ha diritto a tanti dodicesimi della gratifica natalizia quanti sono i mesi di anzianità di servizio presso l’azienda. La frazione di mese superiore ai 15 giorni viene considerata a questi effetti mese intero.". Added: more_than 15 (the file applied the engine default, at least 15 days).

reviews.scope: Art. 47 of the verbale of 28 May 2025 (p. 26, page image): the minimi from 1 April 2027 and 1 January 2028.
findings: Two tranches of 70 EUR at parametro 137, reparametrised per level; the 2025 and 2026 columns equal the file.

reviews.scope: The monthly values of the levels against the primary tables (text layer).
findings: 54 values found verbatim on the cited pages and marked verified; 18 left as they were (derived or not on a text page).

reviews.scope: Art. 36 sickness rules of the CCNL 2024-2028 (alimentare): proposal by one session, field-by-field check of the text by a second independent session.
findings: Comporto as a sum over the 17 months (up to 5 years of seniority, 180 days) or 24 months (over 5 years, 365 days) before the day, 'anche in caso di diverse malattie': modelled as cumulation; 180 days at full net pay, then 50%.
The second session confirmed 15 fields; the window_years fallback and the band boundaries are schema conventions, not contractual windows.

reviews.scope: Art. 47 table of the consolidated text signed on 18 March 2026 (PDF p. 144), read on the page image, against the file and the verbale of 28 May 2025 (p. 26).
findings: 21 minimi of 2026-2028 differed by one or two cents from the later signed text and were corrected.
Both signed documents set four tranches of EUR 70: the 2027 and 2028 tranches are confirmed.

reviews.scope: Panificazione industriale pay of the text signed on 18 March 2026 (PDF p. 145, 147-148, 153-154, 160), read on the page images, against the research of a separate model session on the CCNL 2021.
findings: Added the seven panificazione industriale levels with paga base, contingenza, premio di produzione, premio per obiettivi and scatti.
The contingenza of the sector (art. 47 bis) is new in the 2026 text; the CCNL 2021 had none for these levels.

location.section: Art. 36, 2) Trattamento economico
location.quote:
2) Trattamento economico
   Il trattamento economico del lavoratore non in prova viene stabilito come segue:

                                 Corresponsione         Corresponsione di
             Anzianità di
                                    dell’intera               metà
              servizio
                                   retribuzione           retribuzione
             Fino a 5 anni       per 180 giorni di
                                                           ----------------
               compiuti             calendario
                                 per 180 giorni di       per 185 giorni di
            Oltre i 5 anni
                                    calendario              calendario

    Agli effetti del trattamento economico l’azienda, su documentazione redatta sui
moduli dell’Istituto assicuratore, integrerà l’indennità corrisposta dallo stesso in
modo da raggiungere il 100% o il 50% della retribuzione normale netta.

provenance.transformation: The 2020–2024 selectable-text quotation (PDF p. 112) is corroborated by the signed consolidated 2024–2028 CCNL (https://www.uila.eu/web/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/CCNL-piccola-e-media-industria-alimentare-28-05-2025q.pdf; sha256 1cec66bff121aef674237795a22e01653d3ca8fe7cd17297061e627a80c86dae; art. 36, PDF pp. 126–128, scanned/OCR). Conservation clause on p. 126: 180 calendar days through five years and 365 above five years; sums of different illnesses in the preceding 17 and 24 months respectively. Pay table on pp. 127–128: first 180 days at 100% and days 181–365 for the longer-seniority band at 50%, topping up insurer indemnity to normal net pay. window_years=2 is a required fallback, overridden by window_months=17/24 for both bands; there is no additional 180-day per-episode cap. 60 completed months is the model’s nearest threshold for “oltre 5 anni”; the day immediately after the fifth anniversary cannot be distinguished from the anniversary using completed months.
provenance.note: The cited exact pdftotext -layout quote is from the prior signed, text-selectable edition, not the scanned consolidated edition. The consolidated edition repeats the economic table and adds the disability extension. Carenza rate 1 is retained from the current rule as an inference from full pay for the initial 180 days, not an expressly separate waiting-day rate.

location.section: Art. 31 - Giorni festivi
location.quote: Nel solo caso in cui una delle giornate festive di cui ai precedenti punti a), b) e c) cada di domenica, ai lavoratori è dovuto, in aggiunta al normale trattamento economico, un importo pari ad 1/26° della retribuzione normale di fatto. [...] Per quanto riguarda la festività del 4 novembre, il lavoratore beneficerà del trattamento economico previsto per le festività che coincidono con la domenica.

provenance.transformation: The festività of points a) and b) (but the Patrono of point c) on a Sunday, and 4 November on the first Sunday of November: the monthly pay of the chain over 26.
provenance.note: The text is the 2013 CCNL: the 2016, 2021 and 2025 renewals were not read. The Patrono is not in the national calendar and is not paid. 4 October, a holiday from 2026 (L. 151/2025), is not in the list: its Sunday stays open.
